_doc: GNN model card: what the network is (task, inputs, normalisation, architecture, output) and how it is trained (training). python -m grand_gnn_train --gnn-model-card <this file> builds or reuses its dataset, trains, exports and evaluates it. See README.md and RUNBOOK_CC.md.
name: pgnn_direction_xy
description: pGNN direction of the GNN paper: GNN_forPaper reconstructions/Direction_ADC/after_writing_selection/configs/config_33.json (model_k_h256_l4_d0_seqT_rmean-max-sum_nbatch_i6_pTrue_tr0_nn32_lfGaussianNLLLoss_33). Node features pos x, y, z, time, amplitude, delta_t; plane-wave vector as graph input; EdgeCNN 4 x 256 with batch norm, jk last (sequential true), mean+max readout (what GNNScale used), 32 neighbours, Gaussian NLL, 110 epochs in 4 learning-rate phases, 20 seeds. Peaks on x, y with grand.analysis.signals.
